titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Życie prywatne — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: Private Life — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Dział Życie prywatne: rodzina, znajomi, rutyna dnia, czas wolny. Listy do gier LingoSpark + karty.
blurbEn: Grade-8 Private life module: family, friends, daily routine, free time. Paste-ready LingoSpark lists.

items.definitionEn: a person in your family
items.example: We visit a relative in Kraków every Easter.

items.definitionEn: the child of your aunt or uncle
items.example: My cousin is the same age as me.

items.definitionEn: the son of your brother or sister
items.example: Her nephew starts school in September.

items.definitionEn: the daughter of your brother or sister
items.example: They bought a bike for their niece.

items.definitionEn: to become husband and wife
items.example: My aunt will get married in June.

items.definitionEn: to legally end a marriage
items.example: They decided to get divorced after many arguments.

items.definitionEn: regular jobs at home such as cleaning
items.example: Everyone in the family has household chores.

items.definitionEn: to wash plates and pans after a meal
items.example: I do the washing-up if my brother cooks.

items.definitionEn: to carry the bin bags outside
items.example: Please take out the rubbish before you go to bed.

items.definitionEn: to spend time with friends in a relaxed way
items.example: We hang out at the shopping centre on Saturdays.

items.definitionEn: to not go out in the evening
items.example: I want to stay in and watch a film tonight.

items.definitionEn: to leave home for social reasons
items.example: They go out with friends most Friday evenings.

items.definitionEn: a night spent at a friend's house
items.example: Can I have a sleepover at Anna's on Saturday?

items.definitionEn: the friend you feel closest to
items.example: My best friend sits next to me in class.

items.definitionEn: to stop being friendly after an argument
items.example: They fall out over silly things, then they talk again.

items.definitionEn: to become friends again after an argument
items.example: We always make up before the next lesson.

items.definitionEn: the things you usually do every day in order
items.example: Describe your daily routine from morning to evening.

items.definitionEn: to leave your bed in the morning
items.example: I get up at half past six on school days.

items.definitionEn: to take care of a person or animal
items.example: Can you look after my dog this weekend?

items.definitionEn: to look after a child while the parents are out
items.example: I babysit my little brother on Friday nights.

items.definitionEn: a small amount of money parents give a child
items.example: He saves his pocket money to buy a game.

items.definitionEn: an angry disagreement
items.example: We had an argument about whose turn it was.

items.definitionEn: to do something special because of a happy event
items.example: We celebrate birthdays with a homemade cake.

items.definitionEn: a date you remember each year because something happened then
items.example: Their wedding anniversary is in May.

items.definitionEn: to ask someone to come to an event
items.example: Did you invite the whole class to the party?

items.definitionEn: a person you have invited to your home or event
items.example: Each guest brought a small present.

items.definitionEn: a friend you trust with private things
items.example: I only told that secret to a close friend.

items.definitionEn: someone you know a little, but not a close friend
items.example: He is only an acquaintance from football club.

items.definitionEn: grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins as well as parents
items.example: The whole extended family meets at Christmas.

items.definitionEn: to continue writing or speaking to someone
items.example: We keep in touch by video call every Sunday.

items.definitionEn: to care for a child until they are grown
items.example: It is not easy to bring up two children alone.

items.definitionEn: to stop activity and relax for a while
items.example: Have a rest before you start your homework.

items.definitionEn: an activity you do regularly for pleasure
items.example: Her hobby is taking photos of animals.

items.definitionEn: to use a period of time doing something
items.example: I spend time with my grandparents every weekend.

items.definitionEn: to meet as a group
items.example: Let's get together after the match.

items.definitionEn: unhappy because you are alone
items.example: He felt lonely after his best friend moved away.
